name: Inner Fire (Psionic)
body:
You use psionic power to augment your rampaging elemental abilities.

Prerequisites: Gather power class feature.

Benefit: You can expend your psionic focus while gathering power to reduce the action needed to alleviate burn. If you take a swift action, you are treated as if you had gathered power as a move action. If you take a move action, you are treated as if you gathered power for a full round. You cannot gather power in another way in the same turn you use this feat.
